name: Augusta

tierList.prydwen: T1 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Electro Broadblade Main DPS built around 3 resources: Prowess (enhanced Heavy Attacks), Ascendancy (enhanced Resonance Skill sequence), and Majesty (2 stacks unlock a time-stopping second Ultimate 'Sublime is the Sun' that lands 9 rapid Heavy Attacks + finisher).

skills.normalAttack: Hunter's Path - basic chain plus Prowess-enhanced Heavy Attack variants (Backstep/Spinslash/Uppercut).
skills.resonanceSkill: Warrior's Blade; upgrades to Undying Sunlight Strike/Leap/Plunge sequence at full Ascendancy, granting Majesty.
skills.forte: Call Me By the Sun - governs Ascendancy generation and the enhanced Resonance Skill chain.
skills.liberation: Sunward Conquest - base Sword of Eternal Oath; at 2 Majesty, hold to unleash Sublime is the Sun (7s time-stop, 9x Sunborne hits + Everbright Protector finisher), grants team-wide Ruler's Realm shield-on-Intro.
skills.intro: Stride of Goldenflare - restores full Prowess + 20% Ascendancy.
skills.outro: Battlesong of the Unyielding - next character gains 15% All-DMG Amplification for 14s; grants Augusta a Majesty + Crown of Wills (Electro DMG Bonus) stack.

echoSet: Crown of Valor (5pc, ATK/CRIT DMG stacks on shield application - Augusta uniquely stacks it fully)

teams.name: Team #1 - Best Team
teams.notes: Iuno best Outro buffer (up to 90% DMG Amp); Mortefi/Rebecca close seconds for Heavy DMG buffing; free-to-play friendly with Mortefi.

rotation: Intro -> Backstep+Spinslash x2 -> Skill -> Ultimate (Sword of Eternal Oath) -> Forte Skill chain (Strike/Leap/Plunge) -> Ultimate (Sublime is the Sun: 9x Sunborne + Everbright Protector) -> Outro. Near-incompatible with quickswap since her Outro locks the next character on field and ~half her damage is backloaded into the 2nd Ultimate.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier DPS (T1/T1) with excellent F2P accessibility via Mortefi, higher ceiling with Iuno; weaknesses are backloaded damage (poor for multi-wave Whimpering Wastes timing), negligible shield strength (only exists to trigger set/weapon effects), and near-total incompatibility with quickswap teams. Note: her 2nd Ultimate instantly kills on-field summons, making Phrolova synergy poor.
